content.value: T1 is strongest; T10 is weakest. A material cap is the strongest rune that base can obtain. Random crafting, specialized tomes, artificial choices and dropped equipment all respect that cap.

T10: Wood, [[item/minecraft:stone|Stone]], [[item/minecraft:leather|Leather]], [[item/minecraft:shield|Shields]] and [[item/minecraft:bow|Bows]]. T9: Iron, Chainmail, Gold and [[item/minecraft:crossbow|Crossbows]]. T8: [[item/minecraft:diamond|Diamond]]. T7: Netherite.

A [[item/minecraft:diamond|Diamond]] base can obtain T8, T9 or T10. It cannot obtain T1–T7. A [[item/minecraft:bow|Bow]] or [[item/minecraft:shield|Shield]] remains T10 even with an expensive tome. Choose the base before investing in its runes.
Ordinary, Greater and Perfect random tomes

Ordinary tomes allow every tier from the base cap down to T10. Greater variants remove T10 when possible. Perfect variants remove T9 and T10 when possible. The stronger variants improve the available tier selection; they do not add more affix slots or bypass the material cap.
With an ordinary random tome: about 44.7% T8, 34.2% T9 and 21.1% T10 after a compatible family has been selected.
With a Greater random tome: about 56.7% T8 and 43.3% T9. With a Perfect random tome: T8 is the only eligible tier.
These are tier chances, not the chance to obtain a particular rune family. Existing runes, equipment compatibility and the tome operation still affect which families can be selected.

A specialized tome guarantees its named family at the equipment's material tier. Artificial choices use the best three eligible tiers, or fewer if the base supports fewer. Neither route bypasses the equipment cap.
A good tier is not always a good roll

Values vary inside a tier. Hold Show Details to compare the rolled number with that tier's range. A Divine Tome can improve the selected rune's values without changing its family. It spends the attempt even if the paid comparison leads you to keep the old result.

On a T10-only base, a stronger random tome cannot improve the tier. On a [[item/minecraft:diamond|Diamond]] base, a Perfect variant guarantees the best tier that base allows, but still does not guarantee the family you want. Specialized tomes solve family uncertainty; Divine solves value uncertainty.
